author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Runs free or Viewer Foundation points giveaways that survive a restart, with limited extra tickets, protected controls, announcements on every platform, and winner overlays.
changelog: 4.1.59: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.1.59, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.1: initial release with free and points entry modes, serialized recoverable spending/refunds, secure weighted selection, authenticated lifecycle controls, platform-bounded chat, and responsive giveaway/winner cards.

manifest.name: Village Draw
installationSteps: Install and enable Viewer Foundation first; Village Draw never creates a second points balance.
Keep chat-message triggers on your existing main THSV platform actions. No separate giveaway commands or triggers are needed in Streamer.bot.
Set the prize and entry rules, save, restart, then start the giveaway from the Control Panel.
Add the hosted Village Draw overlay to OBS, Meld, or Streamlabs and send a safe preview.
uninstallationSteps: Cancel and refund an open points draw before uninstalling. Its private history is kept for a later reinstall.

healthChecks.description: Checks that entries are handled one at a time, Viewer Foundation points spent or refunded can be recovered, winners are picked fairly, and result cards show.
